data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'f-l-l', meaning to free, release, or deliver. The name Falilat carries the meaning “Freed, released” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Falilat usually hope their child will grow to embody freed, released and live with faith, good character and purpose.
